 Football
 Two-goal Richard gives Harimau Malaya a lift
 By T. RAHULESH 
 Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026
 | 5:08 PM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Heroic act: Richard Chin opened the scoring in the seventh minute before doubling his tally in the 56th minute. – FAM/Malaysia NT 
 PETALING JAYA: Right winger Richard Chin scored his first two international goals as Harimau Malaya beat Yemen 2-1 in a friendly in Guangdong, China, on Tuesday (Nov 17).
 The 24-year-old opened the scoring in the seventh minute, reacting quickest after goalkeeper Abdullah Al-Sadi's wayward punch to fire home a right-footed volley.
 Richard struck again in the 56th minute when Yemen centreback Emad Al-Godaimah's attempted header back to his goalkeeper went awry, leaving the net exposed for the winger to slot home.
 Substitute Rauf Al-Sheraji pulled one back for Yemen in the 77th minute, but Tan Cheng Hoe's side held on to bounce back from Saturday's 0-2 defeat to China, in which Richard had been one of Malaysia's brighter performers.
